newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Jan, Feb manufacturing employment up 4.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Jan, Feb manufacturing employment up 4.5 pct.

text.p: Employment in Mexico's manufacturing sector rose an average 4.5 percent during the first two months of the year compared to the same months of the previous year, the National Statistics Institute (INEGI) said in a statement on Monday.
Hours worked in the time period rose by an average 4.1 percent compared to the same period the year before.

INEGI said eight of nine sectors measured showed an increase in employment during the first two months. The sectors with the largest increases were in metallic products, machinery and equipment, clothing and leather.
